policy: Allowlist is not blanket republication permission. Check article ownership, exclusions, attribution, source date and license on every edition. Text only; never bypass access restrictions.

sources.name: European Commission News
sources.conditions: EU-owned article text only; exclude third-party works, images and logos unless separately cleared. Retain attribution, original link, license link and modification notice. Individual language pages may be missing or inaccessible.

sources.name: Global Voices
sources.license: CC BY 3.0 Unported, article-level exceptions must be checked
sources.conditions: Credit original author and any named translator; link original and license; disclose adaptation. Exclude externally syndicated or content-sharing-agreement articles without independently verified rights. Image/audio rights are separate. No assumption of daily output in every language.

archiveOnly.name: Wikinews language editions
archiveOnly.reason: IT/DE homepages report closure on 2026-05-04 and read-only archival status. Not a current daily news feed. Licenses differ by language and publication date; verify each fixed revision before reuse.
